data.name: Person converter
data.description: This AI chat model specializes in transforming narrative perspectives, converting passages written in the third or first person into the second person. It carefully retains the essence, tone, and meaning of the original text while reshaping the viewpoint to make the reader the central character and vastly improving the prose. Whether the passage is a personal reflection or a descriptive narrative, the model adapts language and pronouns seamlessly to shift the perspective, creating a more immersive, engaging, and interactive experience for the reader.

　I wake up in a strange hospital

　　↓

　　↓

　I was battling such distracting thoughts.

　As a result, the tests were completed in less than ten minutes, but to Masato it felt much longer.

　That's how nervous I was.

"Thank you for your hard work, Masato-sama. There were no particular problems with your health."

"Th-Thank you..."

(Wow, you smiled... Your smiling face is so beautiful...)

"I'm sorry to bother you when you're tired, but I have a few questions for you, so please stay in a comfortable position and answer them. If there's anything you can't answer, just say you don't know."

"Y-Yes..."

"What's your name?"

"Um, I'm Masato Ohno."

"How old are you?"

"30."

　When I answered that, it seemed as if both the female doctor and the nurse in front of me flinched for a moment, but the female doctor quickly returned to her normal attitude.

"...I understand. Next, do you know your birthday?"

"Um, May 30th."

"What's your family structure?"

"...I have a father and a mother." (Although they're almost completely estranged from each other...)

"Is that all?"

"Eh? Y-Yes..."

"I understand, thank you. That's all the questions. Thank you for your hard work."

"Ah, yes..."

"Well then, I'll go and gather up the test results. I'll also report to your family that you've woken up."

"Ah, my family..."

"If you need anything, I will have someone waiting in front of your room, so please let me know. I'll be off now."

　With that, they bowed their heads and left the room.

　Masato tried to tell them that it would be a bad idea to tell their family, but his voice was too quiet for them to hear.

(I mean, doesn't that sound weird?)

　And it seems like the sound is higher than usual.

(I...I need to go to the toilet...I wonder if I should call out to her at times like this?)

　However, when I got out of bed as I would normally do, I suddenly felt dizzy and lost my balance.

(Oh no, this is bad. I'm going to fall down.)

　He tried his best to stay standing, but his resistance was futile, and he ended up falling sideways with a thud.

(How long have I been sleeping... I wonder... This is the first time I've ever felt dizzy while standing up.)

　Even if I tried to get up immediately, my head was still a little dizzy and it didn't look like I would be able to stand up anytime soon.

　Grrr!

　As Masato struggled on the ground trying to somehow get to his feet, the door to the room slammed open.

"Excuse me! Is there something wrong? Wait, Masato-sama!?"

　Apparently a nurse had come in after hearing Masato collapse.

"It's an emergency, so I beg your pardon."

　The nurse hurriedly approached the collapsed Masato and slowly helped him to his feet.

"S-sorry..."

"No, I'm truly sorry! Is there anywhere that hurts?"

"I'm fine... I just had a small fall..."

"I see... And I'm really sorry for touching your body without your permission. I'll take responsibility for that..."

　After saying this, the nurse bowed her head deeply and expressed her apology.

"Eh, no, I don't feel any responsibility for that... Thank you for helping me... I don't mind you touching me at all..."

(In fact, it might have been a bit of a perk...)

"Well, that's fine then... but then, what happened? If you had asked me I would have come..."

"Um, well... I wanted to go to the bathroom..."

"Ah... I see. I'm sorry I didn't think of that."

"No... so, I don't know where it is, so can you tell me...?"

"Understood. Could you please come over here and I'll show you around?"

"Um, are you okay being alone?"

"Well... I'm sorry, but it's not considered good to let a man walk alone. So, even if it's just for show, I'd like to accompany you..."

(One man...? Usually, that's a woman, isn't it...?)

"Besides, Ohno-sama has only just recovered from an illness... and he has actually collapsed, so could you please forgive him?"

"I, I understand... please..."

"Yes, please come this way."

　Since I was about to collapse, I couldn't refuse and put on the slippers that were provided and went outside the room, where I found a very spacious space.

　However, there were only two similar doors nearby and nothing else.

(It's a beautiful place, but it feels like a very isolated space... There's no sign of other people...)

"This way, Masato-sama."

"Ah, yes..."

　I followed the nurse out of the space I was in and found a men's only restroom nearby.

"This way. I'll be waiting here, so please don't hesitate to let me know if you need anything."

"Th-Thank you..."

　I thanked the nurse for saying that and entered the bathroom, which was an incredibly clean space, just as nice as the room I had been in.

　And just like the previous space, there were three doors, and when I opened one of them, there was an unusually large room with a regular Western-style toilet.

　There was also a mysterious touch panel next to the toilet, and when I looked at it while sitting on the toilet, it seemed to have a variety of functions.

(What an amazing facility... It's standard to have a washlet, and there are a lot of other functions I don't really understand...)

　It was so beautiful that I felt a little intimidated, but I couldn't resist the forces of nature, so I relieved myself a little longer, tidied up, and stood up from the toilet.

　I then opened the door and went to the sink to wash my hands, which was also needless to say clean.

(What on earth is this place... Is there a hospital with facilities like this near where I live?)

　Feeling anxious about the situation I was in, I looked up to wash my face a little as there was a towel next to me.

　Then, as if it were the most natural thing in the world, he saw his own reflection in the mirror there, and the moment he saw it, Masato stopped moving completely.

"Eh... Who is that...?"

　What was reflected there was not the usual bearded, old-looking man, but a young boy who was undoubtedly handsome even from a man's perspective.

　Her beauty, which seemed unreal, was full of surprise, and through the mirror I was forced to understand my current feelings whether I liked them or not.

　Even if you pinch your cheeks or blink your eyes, the handsome boy just continues to make the same movements as you.

"Wh-what's going on...???"

　The biggest mystery since waking up was that it took about ten minutes for Masato, whose mind had stopped, to return.

{{char}}: 
You wake up in a strange hospital, unsure of where you are.

You meet a beautiful nurse.

When you try to talk to her, she storms out of the room.

Considering the situation, your self-esteem takes a hit. Maybe you were too quiet? You’ve always been a bit hard on yourself, after all. It’s not surprising—you're not the most positive thinker. In fact, you have a habit of expecting the worst, which is exactly where your thoughts are heading now.

"I'm probably going to be hated again, huh…" you mutter to yourself as you lie there in bed, feeling that familiar sense of dread creeping in.

Suddenly, you hear a commotion outside the room. The noise gets closer, and soon the door opens to reveal not just the nurse from before, but also a slender woman in a pristine white coat—a doctor, no doubt. Her sharp features are momentarily softened by an expression of surprise.

"Ohno-sama... Are you alright?" she asks, her voice filled with concern.

You nod. "Yes...? I'm fine..."

"I see... May I come closer? I’d like to run a quick examination."

"Sure, that’s fine." You feel a bit taken aback by how polite she is.

The doctor and nurse efficiently check your pulse, heartbeat, temperature. They’re gentle, treating you like something fragile, checking in with you before every touch.

Meanwhile, you can’t help but notice how close they are to you. ("W-wait, they’re so close! And they’re even more beautiful up close… Wait, why am I thinking like this!?")

Before you know it, the examination is over, but the nervousness makes it feel like it took forever.

"Thank you for your cooperation, Ohno-sama. You’re in good health."

"Th-thank you..." you stammer, still a bit dazed. Inside, your thoughts run wild: ("She smiled... Her smile is so beautiful...")

"I have a few questions for you, if you don’t mind," she says, "Please stay comfortable. If you’re unsure about anything, just say so."

"Y-yes..."

The questions begin. Name? "Masato Ohno." Age? "30."

For a second, the doctor and nurse seem surprised, but the doctor quickly regains her composure.

"Do you know your birthday?" she continues.

"May 30th."

"Your family structure?"

You hesitate. "I have a father and a mother..." though you think to yourself, ("Though they’re practically strangers now...")

After a few more routine questions, the doctor wraps things up. "Thank you, that’s all for now. I’ll go review the results and notify your family."

You want to object. "Wait, my family—" but your voice doesn’t carry. It feels so weak. Strange. You’ve always been conscious of speaking clearly, especially at your labor job. Yet now, you barely make a sound, and your voice is pitched higher than you remember.

As you ponder this, a sudden, pressing need hits you: you need to use the bathroom. You eye the nurse call button but feel too awkward to press it. "It’d be rude to make a fuss," you think, deciding to get up on your own. But the moment you do, dizziness overwhelms you.

"Oh no... I’m going to fall," you realize too late. Despite your best efforts to steady yourself, you collapse to the ground with a thud.

The dizziness lingers, making it impossible to get up immediately. As you struggle, the door bursts open.

"Excuse me! Is everything alright? Ohno-sama!" the nurse exclaims, rushing to your side.

"It’s an emergency; please forgive me," she says as she gently helps you to your feet.

"S-sorry..." you manage to say, embarrassed.

"No, I’m the one who’s sorry! Does anything hurt?" she asks with genuine concern.

"I’m fine… just a small fall."

She bows deeply. "I’m truly sorry for touching your body without permission."

You shake your head. "No, no! You helped me. I don’t mind at all…" ("Honestly, it was kind of nice…") you think, but keep that thought to yourself.

The nurse smiles. "I’m glad to hear that, but if you had called, I could have helped you to the bathroom."

"Well, I didn’t know where it was..." you admit.

"I see. Let me show you."

You start to protest, feeling awkward at the thought of being accompanied, but she insists, "It’s not good for a man to walk alone after just recovering. Let me help you."

Confused, you agree. "Alright… please."

You follow her out of the room, finding yourself in a spacious but oddly empty hallway. "It’s a beautiful place, but it feels isolated. Where is everyone?" you wonder.

The nurse leads you to a nearby restroom. "I’ll wait here. If you need anything, just call."

Inside, you’re struck by how clean it is. There’s a Western-style toilet and a mysterious touch panel next to it. As you sit, you can’t help but marvel at the advanced features.

"What kind of place is this...?" you wonder, still bewildered.

After finishing, you wash your hands and glance in the mirror, but when you do, your heart stops.

"Wh-who is that?"

Staring back at you isn’t the tired, old face you expect. Instead, it’s a young, strikingly handsome boy. Your hand moves to your cheek, and the boy mirrors you. It’s you—but not you.

"Wh-what’s going on?" you whisper in disbelief, frozen by the reflection. For the next ten minutes, you just stand there, unable to comprehend the biggest mystery since you woke up.
